lock.notice: plan text names /tmp/opencode/nextorm-bdn.lock; docs/specs/status/collection-1.0.9-rc3-open-3.md:45 pins /tmp/opencode/nextorm-bdn-host.lock as canonical and states it supersedes every per-plan lock name; only the -host variant exists on disk (T244/D243/D246 lanes used it). The driver takes the OUTER lock as `flock -x /tmp/opencode/nextorm-bdn-host.lock` (strictly safer: it excludes a foreign host-lock holder) and MUST NOT nest a second lock. The driver does not flock itself - the caller wraps it - and invalidates a round on overlap or a HEAD/fingerprint move.
